response.rationale: Both translations are accurate for the narrowed computer/communications sense. Indonesian jaringan and Malaysian rangkaian are established technical terms. The contrast is a useful difference in common preferred forms, not a false-friend contrast; jaringan is also encountered in Malaysian technical usage, so the distinction should not be taught as exclusive.
